title: OlarHike Air Bed for 2 People — 200 x 140 x 50 cm, up to 300 kg
short_description: Raised air bed for 2 people (200 x 140 x 50 cm), self-inflating according to the manufacturer and supports up to 300 kg. With carry bag and repair patch — for car camping, large tents and guests at home.
long_description: The OlarHike air bed (model AMH5V3) offers space for two people at 200 x 140 cm. At 50 cm high, it sits almost like a regular bed, making it easier to get up. According to the manufacturer, it is self-inflating, medium-firm and supports up to 300 kg. It is made of multi-layer PVC; a carry bag and repair patch are included, along with a 2-year manufacturer's warranty. At 7.6 kg, it is better suited for car camping, large family tents and as a guest bed at home than for backpacking.
features: 50 cm high – almost like a bed
buying_angle: Practical for couples and families car camping or hosting guests who want a high, comfortable air bed.
